name: Cloak of Displacement (Minor)
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 262, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 507
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 262, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 507
Aura faint illusion; CL 3rd
Slot shoulders; Price 24,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
This item appears to be a normal cloak, with a pattern very similar to a major cloak of displacement nocturnal designs, but when worn its magical properties distort and warp light waves. This displacement works similar to the blur spell, granting a 20% miss chance on attacks against the wearer. It functions continually.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, blur; Cost 12,000 gp
